note: USFS Lolo National Forest campground on US-12, 26 mi west of Lolo near Lolo Pass, on Lolo and Lee creeks. 2 loops (17 sites in lodgepole timber above the highway, 5 in pine/spruce near the creek); no drinking water in fall. Hot spring resort within 1 mi; Lolo Pass Visitor Center 6 mi west. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (no rec.gov listing; Forest Service-run): confirmed 30-ft spurs, vault toilets, potable water, $15 peak fee (fees left as recorded); season changed from 'not year-round' to May 15 - Sept 8 (2026 dates). Not stated: site count, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left). No alerts for the campground or US-12. Note trimmed of restated values and the 'late May-mid Sept' season the page contradicts.
